text:
maria: Quick sync — landing page + webinar registration SEO checklist. Need keywords, event schema, internal linking, and redirects for older blog posts that mention the feature.
aj: timeline?
maria: Webinar is 2026-04-15, landing goes live 2026-04-01. Need final SEO pass by 2026-03-29.
sam: I'll own keyword map and internal linking. Will push CSV to /drive by EOD Wed.
maria: Thanks — focus keyword families: 'low latency LLM inference', 'dedicated GPU inference', 'LLM inference cost optimization'. Keep primary intent pages mapped and canonicalized.
olivia: I'll handle JSON-LD event schema + meta tags. Draft here:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Launch webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-04-15T10:00:00-07:00",
  "location": {"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.inference/webinar/april-2026"}
}
```
aj: Need to ensure structured data is included server-side on landing (no client-only hydration). devex, fyi.
seo-bot: Found 3 old blog slugs to redirect: /blog/latency-tuning -> /resources/latency, /blog/dedicated-nodes -> /products/dedicated, /blog/embedding-costs -> /guides/embeddings-costs
maria: Good. Sam — please create a redirect map with 301 targets and owner tags. Include test plan for GA UTM preservation.
sam: Will do. Also propose internal anchor links: hero -> webinar details -> benchmark narrative -> docs deep dive. Want canonical tags pointing to launch landing for syndicated copies.
olivia: Also propose FAQ schema in the post-launch recap to capture SERP features.
aj: Who's shipping meta robots and canonical? eng-frontend or eng-platform?
maria: eng-frontend owns initial template. We'll coordinate with eng-platform for redirect rules.
olivia: Quick note: ensure hreflang not needed for now. US+EU only.
maria: Perfect — deliverables: sam keyword map + redirect CSV by 3/29, olivia JSON-LD + FAQ schema by 3/27, aj to confirm infra by 3/30. Ping me with blockers. :rocket:
